insights.text: tester-army/e2e leads today's captured GitHub Trending list with 1,725 stars today and 6,546 total. Its README describes agent-assisted browser and mobile checks inside a test workflow, but independent reliability and defect-detection evidence are absent.

insights.text: mattpocock/skills reappears at #2 in today's GitHub Trending capture with 889 stars today and 278,362 total, following its absence from yesterday's captured board. This supports ranking volatility and continuing attention, not a conclusion about skill use.

insights.text: Google DeepMind describes EmbeddingGemma 2 as a shared embedding space for text/code, images, video, and audio, with modality encoders that can be loaded selectively. The model card lists 740M parameters; this pass did not run the model on a phone or independently reproduce vendor benchmark scores.

insights.text: The captured Hugging Face listing shows google/embeddinggemma-2 at 364 downloads and 596 likes. This is a one-time leaderboard snapshot, not a download trend or proof of mobile adoption.

insights.text: Mistral's first-party launch page describes Large 4 as a public-preview API and says weights are planned later in October. Its reported model and benchmark details remain vendor-presented pending public weights and independent evaluation.

GitHub Trending also records earthtojake/text-to-cad at 619 stars today (18,079 total). Its description frames the project as giving agents CAD capabilities, but the single-day capture cannot establish adoption or output quality.

Photoc's README describes a CLI for photo review and organization with preview-first file operations; it states originals remain unchanged unless explicit apply/in-place flags are used. The Show HN capture shows 62 points and 11 comments, a discussion signal rather than user validation.
insights.source: Photoc README and HN Show capture

insights.text: The Play Store scrape provides a single top-app listing, without rank history or download velocity. No trend, adoption, or ASO shift is inferred from today's snapshot.
